doc: One layer of a scatter plot (design/plotter.md, Plotters): kinds placed together under one spacing rule, resolved in order.

fields.name: spacing_m
fields.doc: Minimum distance between this layer's things, centre to centre, metres.

fields.name: density
fields.doc: Target things per 100 cells (about 260 square metres), before fields scale it. At most about 260 / (pi spacing^2) per 100 cells fit.

fields.name: grove_low
fields.doc: Density multiplier where the grove field is lowest (clearings).

fields.name: grove_high
fields.doc: Density multiplier where the grove field is highest (groves).

fields.name: edge_low
fields.doc: Density multiplier on the region's border cells, easing to 1 at edge_cells in.

fields.name: edge_cells
fields.doc: How many cells in from the border the edge effect reaches (0: none).

fields.name: ground
fields.doc: Bits of the grounds this layer accepts (bit n: ground n: soil, water, rock, sand, path).

fields.name: max_height_delta_m
fields.doc: The most the ground heights under a footprint may differ, metres: placements look for smoothish ground.

fields.name: prefer_near
fields.doc: Where this layer gathers, near earlier layers' things.

fields.name: regrows
fields.doc: Whether a regrow-mode grow fills this layer again.

fields.name: kinds
fields.doc: The kinds a seed-mode grow places.

fields.name: regrow_kinds
fields.doc: The kinds a regrow-mode grow places (empty: the same as kinds).
